Light wave radius about 190: deals 2 damage and heavy knockback to enemies in range and clears enemy orbs; briefly invulnerable on cast; can break shield shades' shields.
擁有 3 點護盾（血量只有 4），受傷先扣護盾；脫離受傷 4 秒後，每秒恢復 0.5 點。盾擊向前衝撞約 150 像素，路徑上的敵人受到 2 點傷害、擊退並暈眩 0.5 秒，護盾立刻回滿。

Has 3 shield points (only 4 HP); damage hits the shield first; after 4 s without damage it regens 0.5/s. Shield Bash rams about 150 px, dealing 2 damage, knockback and a 0.5 s stun on the path, and refills the shield.
血量最高、移動慢。被動：對自己光圈內的敵人傷害 +30%（光圈外沒有加成）。燈火壓制：10 秒內光圈範圍 +40%、增傷提高到 +45%。血量越少光圈越小，增傷範圍也跟著縮小。

Highest HP, slow movement. Passive: +30% damage to enemies inside your light circle (none outside). Lamp Suppression: for 10 s circle range +40% and bonus up to +45%. Less HP shrinks the circle and the bonus area.
放出 10 隻追蹤螢火，持續 5 秒，每隻最多命中 3 次、每次傷害 1.5；沒有敵人時會回到你身邊。
Releases 10 homing fireflies for 5 s, each hitting up to 3 times for 1.5 damage; with no enemies they return to you.
朝瞄準方向衝刺約 200 像素，路徑上的敵人各受到 5 點傷害；衝刺中與衝刺結束後 1 秒內都不會被打中，可以打碎護盾影的盾。
Dash about 200 px toward the aim, dealing 5 damage to each enemy on the path; untouchable during and 1 s after the dash; can break shield shades' shields.
在面前折出一面約 160 寬的紙牆，持續 4 秒，擋住敵方子彈；你的子彈可以穿過。
Folds a paper wall about 160 wide for 4 s that blocks enemy bullets; your bullets pass through.
暖光半徑約 170，自己恢復 1 點燈火（專屬強化後 2 點），範圍內隊友恢復 1 點，並清除敵方光球。血量已滿時改為給自己 4 秒護身（敵人的攻擊有一半無效）。油燈槍命中敵人會縮短暖光冷卻 0.3 秒。

Warm light radius about 170: restores 1 lamplight to you (2 with the exclusive upgrade) and 1 to allies in range, and clears enemy orbs. At full HP it gives you a 4 s ward instead (half of enemy attacks are negated). Oil Lamp Gun hits cut the cooldown by 0.3 s.
召喚 2 盞小燈籠繞著你轉，各自朝最近的敵人發射火球（傷害 1.5），持續 8 秒；小燈籠本身也是光源。燈籠被敵方子彈打到會消失，要保護它們。
Summons 2 small lanterns that orbit you, each firing fireballs (damage 1.5) at the nearest enemy for 8 s; they are light sources too. Enemy bullets destroy them, so protect them.
朝瞄準方向瞬間移動約 250 像素（遇到障礙會停下），原地留下殘影吸引敵人 2 秒，移動後短暫無敵；影遁後 3 秒內的第一次攻擊傷害 +50%。初始武器影刃：長按 F 連續揮出近戰扇形。

Teleports about 250 px toward the aim (stops at obstacles), leaving an afterimage that lures enemies for 2 s, with brief invulnerability after moving; the first attack within 3 s after Shadow Step deals +50% damage. Starting weapon Shadow Blade: hold F for continuous melee arcs.
變身成紙燈籠 10 秒，結束後才開始冷卻 20 秒。變身期間不能使用武器，改按 F 衝刺（約 0.5 秒一次）；碰撞傷害無效，但子彈與地面傷害仍會受傷，只有衝刺的那一瞬間完全無敵。衝刺撞到敵人造成傷害，連續命中時傷害逐次提高（每次 +30%），衝刺落空就重新計算；每次重新變身也重新計算。

Turns into a paper lantern for 10 s; the 20 s cooldown starts after it ends. No weapons while transformed; press F to dash (about every 0.5 s). Contact damage is ignored but bullets and ground damage still hurt; only the instant of a dash is fully invulnerable. Dashing into enemies deals damage that grows with consecutive hits (+30% each) and resets on a miss or on re-transforming.
在自己腳下展開半徑約 230 的緩速區，持續 5 秒：區內敵人的行動與出招節奏、敵方子彈的速度都變成一半（Boss 約 65%）。緩速區留在原地，你可以引敵人進去，或自己站在區裡打。

Opens a slow zone of radius about 230 under you for 5 s: enemies' movement, attack tempo and bullet speed inside drop to half (boss about 65%). The zone stays put; lure enemies in or fight from inside it.
在瞄準方向前方種下一顆種子，約 1 秒後長成花，存在 10 秒，同時最多 3 朵。花會自己朝最近的敵人攻擊，**攻擊方式沿用種下時你手上的武器**（子彈類發射同樣的子彈、近戰類在花的位置揮擊），射速約為本人的一半、傷害約 70%。換不同武器種花，就是不同的花。

Plants a seed ahead; it blooms in about 1 s, lasts 10 s, up to 3 at once. Flowers attack the nearest enemy on their own, **using the weapon you held when planting** (projectile weapons fire the same bullets, melee swings at the flower), at about half your fire rate and 70% damage. Different weapons make different flowers.
吹出一陣寒風，視野範圍內的敵人凍結 1.2 秒（Boss 0.5 秒），並清除敵方光球；凍結的敵人受到的傷害 +20%。在極地主題，凍結時間 +0.3 秒、冷卻 −2 秒，且自己被凍結的機率減半、時間 −0.3 秒。被動：近戰擊退 +30%。

Blows a cold wind: enemies in view freeze for 1.2 s (boss 0.5 s) and enemy orbs are cleared; frozen enemies take +20% damage. In the Polar theme, +0.3 s freeze, −2 s cooldown, and your own freeze chance halves with −0.3 s duration. Passive: melee knockback +30%.
被動：商人房與臨時攤位的價格都 −4（最低 1 燈芯）。技能：在腳邊擺一座攤位，小商人會跟你打招呼，攤位 12 秒內賣：補血、一件隨機強化、護身小物。冷卻以房間計算：進入 3 個新房間後才能再擺。逃離模式例外：改成移動半個房間的距離（480；攤位強化後約 320）才能再擺。

Passive: merchant-room and pop-up stall prices −4 (min 1 wick). Skill: sets up a stall at your feet with a little merchant, selling healing, a random upgrade and a ward trinket for 12 s. Cooldown counts rooms: enter 3 new rooms before setting up again. Escape mode instead needs half a room of movement (480; about 320 with the stall upgrade).
按技能入睡 5 秒：移速 ×0.4、視野縮到血量 1 的大小、不能攻擊。睡滿 5 秒醒來：範圍攻擊（半徑 130、傷害 3）並回復 2 點燈火。睡眠中被打到會提前醒來：只有範圍攻擊，沒有回血。睡眠中再按一次技能可主動醒來（同樣沒有回血）。冷卻 25 秒，從醒來起算。

Sleep for 5 s: speed ×0.4, sight shrinks to 1 HP's size, no attacking. Waking after the full 5 s: area attack (radius 130, damage 3) and 2 lamplight restored. Being hit wakes you early: area attack only, no healing. Press the skill again to wake manually (no healing). 25 s cooldown from waking.
糖果世界：護送＋守燈各通關一次
Candy World: clear Escort and Guard once each
把自己包成糖殼，可以擋 3 次傷害（25 秒內沒用完會融化）；糖殼碎裂時會往四周迸出 6 片糖碎片，會彈射並傷敵。專屬武器糖漿鞭：近距離揮鞭，命中的敵人被黏住、減速 40%（2 秒），連續命中同一隻黏性疊加，第 3 層暈 0.6 秒。

Wraps you in a sugar shell that blocks 3 hits (melts if unused within 25 s); when it shatters it bursts 6 ricocheting shards that hurt enemies. Exclusive weapon Syrup Whip: close-range whip; hit enemies are stuck and slowed 40% (2 s), stacking on repeat hits, the 3rd stack stuns 0.6 s.
電玩世界：無盡抵達第 6 層＋逃離通關各一次
Arcade World: reach floor 6 in Endless and clear Escape once each
讀檔：回到約 3 秒前的位置，血量取「現在」與「3 秒前」較高者，並有 0.8 秒無敵。冷卻很長（45 秒）。專屬武器乒乓砲：彈球碰牆與障礙會反彈 3 次，每次傷害 +30%，之後折返；彈球靠近時再按攻擊鍵可以接球（完美接球：下一發 ×1.5）；沒接到就消失、裝填 1.2 秒。

Load Save: return to your position of about 3 s ago, with HP the higher of “now” and “3 s ago”, plus 0.8 s invulnerability. Very long cooldown (45 s). Exclusive weapon Ping-Pong Cannon: the ball bounces 3 times off walls and obstacles (+30% damage each) then returns; press attack as it nears to catch it (perfect catch: next shot ×1.5); a miss makes it vanish and reload for 1.2 s.
未來世界：守燈＋逃離各通關一次
Future World: clear Guard and Escape once each
座標標記：對最近的敵人（有 Boss 時優先）打上標記，3 秒後在標記處引爆（半徑 130、傷害 8）；施放時清除身邊 170 像素的敵方子彈，引爆時清除標記處 150 像素的敵方子彈。專屬武器校準槍：可穿透的子彈，傷害隨距離遞減（100 像素內 ×1.3、300 ×1.0、500 ×0.7、700 ×0.4）。

Coordinate Mark: marks the nearest enemy (bosses first) and detonates it after 3 s (radius 130, damage 8); casting clears enemy bullets within 170 px of you, detonation clears those within 150 px of the mark. Exclusive weapon Calibrator Gun: piercing bullets whose damage falls with distance (×1.3 within 100 px, ×1.0 at 300, ×0.7 at 500, ×0.4 at 700).
DLC2：字母書房＋彼岸各通關一次，或 DLC2 長線通關一次
DLC2: clear Letter Study and Other Shore once each, or clear the DLC2 Long Run once
渡燈：在身邊召喚 2 名燈火隊員（血量 2，各自發出一圈光），存在 14 秒，會自動朝最近的敵人射擊（傷害 1.2、每 0.9 秒）；消失時迸出光圈，清掉附近的敵方子彈；再次施放會取代舊的。專屬武器擺渡篙：向前戳刺，射程長、貫穿一整列，戳中的敵人被推開。

Lamp Crossing: summons 2 lamp allies (2 HP, each emitting a ring of light) for 14 s that auto-fire at the nearest enemy (damage 1.2 every 0.9 s); they burst into a light ring when they vanish, clearing nearby enemy bullets; recasting replaces the old ones. Exclusive weapon Ferry Pole: long thrust piercing a whole row, pushing hit enemies away.
佛寺：修行路＋渡化道場各通關一次
Temple: clear Path of Practice and Salvation Dojo once each
起拍：接下來 5 次攻擊傷害 ×1.8。技能冷卻不看時間，而是累積能量（需要 60）：每造成 1 點傷害 +1，每損失 1 點燈火 +8（每間房最多靠受傷充能 2 次）。強化二：加成攻擊會震開附近敵人並清除範圍內的敵方子彈。專屬武器節拍棒：快速短棒，揮擊範圍內的敵方子彈會被打掉。

Downbeat: the next 5 attacks deal ×1.8 damage. Cooldown isn't time but energy (60 needed): +1 per damage dealt, +8 per lamplight lost (at most 2 hurt-charges per room). Upgrade 2: boosted attacks shove nearby enemies and clear enemy bullets in range. Exclusive weapon Beat Stick: quick short stick that knocks down enemy bullets in swing range.
愛情＋星座宇宙各通關一次
Clear Love and Constellation Cosmos once each
星陣：以自己為中心放出衝擊波（半徑 200、傷害 3.4、擊退，並清除敵方子彈），同時在面前立起一道存在 5 秒的星障：擋住敵方子彈，也把靠近的敵人（Boss 除外）推開並灼傷。技能最多累積 3 次，一開始有 1 次；每一次充能需要 120 能量：每造成 1 點傷害 +1（單次最多 12），每損失 1 點燈火 +8（每間房最多靠受傷充能 2 次）。專屬武器星盤：單發的星光彈。

Star Array: releases a shockwave around you (radius 200, damage 3.4, knockback, clears enemy bullets) and raises a 5 s star barrier ahead that blocks enemy bullets and pushes away and scorches approaching enemies (bosses excepted). Stores up to 3 charges, starting with 1; each needs 120 energy: +1 per damage dealt (max 12 at once), +8 per lamplight lost (at most 2 hurt-charges per room). Exclusive weapon Star Disc: single starlight shot.
傳統節慶＋季節慶典各通關一次
Clear Traditional Festival and Seasonal Festival once each
疾送：向前衝刺約 260 像素（途中無敵、撞到的敵人受 2.5 傷害）；衝刺後 2 秒內，只要在移動，就會在身後留下火光（每走約 26 像素一團，存在 1.8 秒），敵人碰到火光每 0.35 秒受 1.3 傷害。冷卻不看時間，而是累積移動距離（需要 1400 像素），衝刺也算。被動：移動速度 ×1.3、燈火只有 4。專屬武器信使短刃：快速短揮。

Swift Delivery: dash about 260 px forward (invulnerable en route, enemies hit take 2.5); for 2 s after, moving leaves flames behind (one per ~26 px, lasting 1.8 s) that deal 1.3 every 0.35 s to enemies touching them. Cooldown is distance moved (1400 px needed), dashing counts. Passive: move speed ×1.3, only 4 lamplight. Exclusive weapon Courier Dagger: quick short slashes.
希臘神話＋日本觀光維護各通關一次
Clear Greek Myth and Japan Tourism Upkeep once each
共鳴：持續 6 秒。手上武器是遠程（無法清子彈）時，每次攻擊會清除前方 230 像素內的敵方子彈；手上武器是近戰或戳刺（本來就能清子彈）時，每次攻擊額外射出一發遠距離貫穿彈（傷害 2.4）。專屬武器迴響弓：快速的遠程單發。

Resonance: lasts 6 s. With a ranged weapon (can't clear bullets), each attack clears enemy bullets within 230 px ahead; with a melee or thrust weapon (already clears bullets), each attack also fires a long-range piercing shot (damage 2.4). Exclusive weapon Echo Bow: fast ranged single shot.
立塔：在面前放置燈塔（最多 2 座，放第 3 座時最舊的消失）。燈塔血量 10、範圍半徑約 110；敵人（含 boss）無法進入範圍，但子彈可以穿過；敵人子彈打到塔會損壞它，貼著邊緣的敵人每 0.5 秒受 1.2 傷害，也會慢慢磨損塔。塔壞掉後留下閃光區（6 秒），區內敵人持續受傷並提供光亮。冷卻 16 秒。專屬武器鑄火槍：單發火花彈。

Raise Tower: places a lighthouse ahead (max 2; the 3rd replaces the oldest). Tower HP 10, radius about 110; enemies (bosses too) can't enter, but bullets pass; enemy bullets damage the tower; enemies at its edge take 1.2 every 0.5 s and slowly wear it down. When it breaks it leaves a 6 s flash zone that keeps hurting enemies and gives light. 16 s cooldown. Exclusive weapon Forge Gun: single spark shot.
紅線光：對最近（優先瞄準中）的敵人綁上紅線，持續 8 秒（boss 減半為 4 秒）。被綁的敵人改為追著其他敵人跑，它發射的子彈變成我方子彈（傷害 ×2），碰到其他敵人也會造成傷害，不再傷害你。冷卻不看時間，每次攻擊減 1，需要 12 次攻擊。專屬武器紅線針：單發紅針。

Red Thread Light: ties a red thread to the nearest enemy (the one you aim at first) for 8 s (boss halved to 4 s). The tied enemy chases other enemies, its bullets become yours (damage ×2), it hurts other enemies on contact and no longer hurts you. Cooldown counts attacks: −1 per attack, 12 needed. Exclusive weapon Red Thread Needle: single red needle.

製作工具：短按空白鍵＝切換圖紙；長按 1 秒（期間不能攻擊、移動變慢）＝製作目前圖紙的工具。冷卻不看時間，而是累積擊倒敵人數（火藥桶 6、冰霜瓶 5、毒氣罐 7、燈油陷阱 8、鏡面反射板 10）。開局會 3 張圖紙：火藥桶（3 秒引信或敵人靠近就爆炸，範圍 154、12 傷害）、冰霜瓶（扔出去，緩速區 6 秒）、毒氣罐（毒雲半徑 119、6 秒，每秒 2 傷害；冰霜瓶半徑 133；火區半徑 105；鏡面長度 ×1.4）；強化「圖紙研究」每層多學一張：燈油陷阱（敵人踩到點燃火區 4 秒）、鏡面反射板（8 秒，反彈敵人子彈並增傷）。場上最多 8 個工具。專屬武器煉金試管：單發試管彈。

Craft Tool: tap Space = switch blueprint; hold 1 s (no attacking, slower movement) = craft the current blueprint's tool. Cooldown counts enemies defeated (powder keg 6, frost flask 5, gas canister 7, oil trap 8, mirror reflector 10). You start with 3 blueprints: powder keg (3 s fuse or explodes when enemies approach, radius 154, 12 damage), frost flask (thrown, 6 s slow zone), gas canister (poison cloud radius 119, 6 s, 2 damage/s; frost radius 133; fire zone radius 105; mirror length ×1.4); the upgrade “Blueprint Study” teaches one more per level: oil trap (ignites a 4 s fire zone when stepped on) and mirror reflector (8 s, reflects enemy bullets and boosts damage). Up to 8 tools on the field. Exclusive weapon Alchemy Vial: single vial shot.
光爆：每次命中敵人 +2 能量（上限 100，開場 30）；被打到 −10。能量滿了按技能鍵，對全場敵人造成 15 點傷害、清除敵方子彈、能量歸零（之後有 2 秒的短暫冷卻）。強化「聚能迴路」：L1 命中 +3、大招 ×1.3；L2 大招後 2 秒無敵、3 秒內被打到不扣能量。專屬武器蓄光燈：連射光彈。

Light Burst: +2 energy per hit (max 100, start 30); −10 when hit. When full, press the skill: 15 damage to all enemies, enemy bullets cleared, energy reset (then a short 2 s cooldown). Upgrade “Energy Circuit”: L1 +3 per hit and ultimate ×1.3; L2 2 s invulnerability after the ultimate and no energy loss from hits for 3 s. Exclusive weapon Charge Lamp: rapid-fire light shots.
地圖上會隨機位置出現光圈（半徑約 110，12 秒換位置，換位前 1.5 秒閃爍）。站在光圈內傷害 ×1.4 並每 4 秒回復 1 燈芯；圈外傷害 ×0.85。技能：額外生成一個光圈（存在 8 秒，最多 3 個）。強化「光圈擴張」：L1 半徑 +25%、圈內 ×1.6；L2 離圈 1 秒內仍保有加成、最多 4 個光圈。專屬武器定光槍：單發彈。

Light circles appear at random spots (radius about 110, relocating every 12 s, flickering 1.5 s before). Standing inside gives damage ×1.4 and 1 wick every 4 s; outside damage ×0.85. Skill: spawn an extra circle (lasts 8 s, max 3). Upgrade “Circle Expansion”: L1 radius +25% and in-circle ×1.6; L2 keep the bonus 1 s after leaving, up to 4 circles. Exclusive weapon Hold-Light Gun: single shot.

; each part holds only 1, a new one replaces the old)
點一件還沒有的外觀，扣除紙屑立刻合成。
Tap a look you don't own to fuse it instantly with scrap.

The cosmetic machine opens after clearing a Long Run or DLC2 (Letter Study, Other Shore) once; you can also try it early by ticking “Test: enable cosmetic machine” on the class screen. Looks are generic shapes tinted by theme, not final art.
紙片收入（每局結算）：基本 5；通關 +10；每個新成就 +5；長線作戰每層 +3（追加層每層 +5）。
Paper income (per run): base 5; +10 for a clear; +5 per new achievement; +3 per floor of a Long Run (+5 for extra floors).
十連抽（90 紙片，至少 1 個稀有）
合成：用紙屑換一件還沒有的
Fuse: trade scrap for a look you don't own
每個部位（頭部／身體／燈具／掛飾）限 1 個，匯入代碼合成；每個部位首次解鎖花 10 紙片，之後免費更換。
One per part (head/body/lamp/charm); import a code to fuse; the first unlock of each part costs 10 paper, later swaps are free.
格式：LKC1:{"s":部位,"n":名稱,"c":主色,"c2":副色,"p":[[x,y],…],"q":[[x,y],…]}；p 為主多邊形（3～16 點、座標 -24～24，原點在該部位錨點，y 向下），q 為選填的副色多邊形。

Format: LKC1:{"s":part,"n":name,"c":main color,"c2":second color,"p":[[x,y],…],"q":[[x,y],…]}; p is the main polygon (3–16 points, coordinates −24 to 24, origin at the part's anchor, y down), q is an optional secondary polygon.
機率：普通 70%、稀有 25%、傳說 5%；每 30 抽保底 1 個傳說；重複的外觀變成紙屑（普通 1、稀有 3、傳說 10）；合成價：普通 5、稀有 15、傳說 40 紙屑。抽到的外觀到「造型」頁裝備（頭飾、身衣、燈飾、小飾品四欄）。

Odds: Common 70%, Rare 25%, Legendary 5%; a legendary is guaranteed every 30 draws; duplicates become scrap (Common 1, Rare 3, Legendary 10); fuse prices: Common 5, Rare 15, Legendary 40 scrap. Equip drawn looks on the Cosmetics page (headwear, outfit, lamp, charm).
最初的那一盞，顏色像傍晚的窗。
The very first lamp, colored like a window at dusk.
通關的人，才認得這種冷靜的光。
Only those who have cleared it recognize this calm light.
打倒五百隻影子之後，燈學會了安靜地發亮。
After five hundred shades, the lamp learned to shine quietly.
三位同伴的光混在一起，就是這個顏色。
Mix the light of three companions and you get this color.
洗過很多次，還是看得出來，是走過很多路的紅。
Washed many times, you can still tell: a red that has walked many roads.
沒有受過傷的人，才配得上這片海。
Only the unhurt deserve this sea.
每個職業都走完一遍，連披風都鍍上了光。
Every class completed, even the cape is gilded with light.
Just one more person to finish.
The farther you go, the longer the cape.
折過一千隻紙鶴，願望還是同一個。
A thousand cranes folded, the wish is still the same.
風一來，扇子自己就開了。
When the wind comes, the fan opens by itself.
雨天擋雨，晴天擋太亮的燈。
Shields rain on wet days, and too-bright lamps on sunny ones.
別人的羽毛，自己的故事。
Someone else's feather, your own story.
The first cut is always the most hesitant.
Whatever is cut blooms into a flower.
The boat sails on imagination, not water.
折到最後一次，才發現是王冠。
On the final fold it turns out to be a crown.
透明的，所以每一滴都藏不住。
燈油是最貴的，所以壺也要。
Lamp oil is the priciest, so the pot must be too.
盾碎過很多次，金邊是補上去的。
The shield broke many times; the gold edge is the mending.
孩子們說，那是把星星關在罩子裡。
The children say it's stars locked inside a shade.
她說，這樣燈火看起來比較有精神。
She says it makes the lamplight look livelier.
燈芯留太長，就變成了火。
Leave the wick too long and it becomes a flame.
面具後面的人，從來不說自己是誰。
The one behind the mask never says who they are.
彎彎的，像一盞還沒點亮的燈。
Curved, like a lamp not yet lit.
雪落在鐘上，聲音就變軟了。
Snow on the bell softens its sound.
One strike, and the whole mountain hears.
開店的人，也得先學會揉麵。
Even a shopkeeper must first learn to knead dough.
字寫壞了，就把燈蓋上，裝作什麼也沒發生。
If the writing goes wrong, cover the lamp and pretend nothing happened.
開在河的另一邊，卻替這一邊照著路。
Blooming on the other bank, yet lighting the way on this one.
每一塊積木，都替你記著一個字。
Each block remembers a letter for you.
花開的時候，沒有誰在數日子。
When flowers bloom, no one counts the days.
遮得住太陽，遮不住想說話的眼睛。
It shades the sun, not the eyes that want to speak.
有人點了很久，從沒想過要熄。
Someone lit it long ago and never thought of putting it out.
飄過去的，都是放下了的。
What drifts away has been let go.
洗了很多次，所以什麼都不再執著。
Washed so many times, it clings to nothing.
翻開的那一頁，永遠是你還沒讀過的。
The page you open is always one you haven't read.
擺渡的人不說話，只負責把你送到岸邊。
The ferryman says nothing; he only carries you to shore.
它不屬於這一岸，所以特別紅。
It doesn't belong to this shore, hence its special red.
頭上的三個點，是三個放下的念頭。
The three dots on the head are three thoughts let go.
泥裡長出來，卻一點也不髒。
Grown from mud, yet not at all dirty.
一針一線，都是別人放下的東西。
Every stitch is something someone else put down.
勝利的人不一定是最強的，是走出迷宮的。
The victor isn't always the strongest, but the one who left the labyrinth.
頭盔上的紅羽毛，是從碎掉的陶罐裡撿來的。
The helmet's red plume was picked from a broken clay jar.
雙耳瓶裡裝的不是酒，是一整個港口的黃昏。
The amphora holds not wine but a whole harbor's dusk.
一點橄欖油，就能點亮整個下午。
A little olive oil lights a whole afternoon.
神祇們都說，這件很適合你。
The gods all say this suits you.
最後一顆櫻桃，總是留給戴帽子的人。
The last cherry is always saved for the one wearing the hat.
融化之前，每一層顏色都很認真。
Before melting, every layer of color is in earnest.
畫面有點雪花，可是你的臉很清楚。
The screen is a bit snowy, but your face is clear.
接住的每一個球，都變成一枚硬幣。
Every ball you catch turns into a coin.
擋住的是光，看清的是距離。
It blocks the light and reveals the distance.
視野裡的數字，永遠比你快一步。
The numbers in view are always a step ahead of you.
河上開了一朵花，是給迷路的人看的。
A flower blooms on the river, for the lost to see.
一盞接一盞，全是同行的人。
Lamp after lamp, all fellow travelers.
抱著它，連噩夢都會睡著。
Hold it and even nightmares fall asleep.
醒著的人，才覺得這是夢遊。
Only those awake call this sleepwalking.
DLC 成就（要先載入該 DLC）
